title: Understanding cycle tracking as a self-care tool
content: Educational note: cycle tracking can help you notice recurring symptoms, energy shifts, and timing patterns. The goal is awareness, not perfection.

title: Hydration, sleep, and fatigue are linked
content: Educational note: if fatigue feels persistent, review sleep, hydration, meals, and stress before assuming it is only one cause. Small habit changes can help clarify patterns.

title: Gentle nutrition beats restrictive habits
content: Educational note: sustainable nutrition works best when it feels realistic. Balanced meals, regular hydration, and enough protein often support better day-to-day energy.
